content.title: Stifel Hires Launny Steffens, Ex-Merrill Leader and Co-founder of Spring Mountain Capital
content.summary: Stifel  Financial is hiring Launny Steffens, a former Merrill Lynch leader, and acquiring part of the investment firm he co-founded, Spring Mountain Capital, the financial services company said.  Steffens will serve as vice chairman of asset management at Stifel.  In the newly created role, he will help the company grow its financial advisor network, build on its asset management capabilities, and find new investment banking opportunities, according to Stifel.
